description: DXF reverse engineering: parallel-chord triangulated truss
message: Build a calculation model from the attached structural DXF and engineering specification, then run static analysis. Read geometry, topology, supports, and nodal loads from the DXF instead of assuming them.

Reconstruct geometry, topology, supports, and load placement from the task.
